referenceScope: Pinned native/default content composition; original static Figma variants remain in stories. Source wrapper APIs and optional native render semantics are described in CEM/README.

contractCases.expected: Root value is required number|null; null or nonfinite is indeterminate with no aria-valuenow. Finite values are clamped to min/max, normalized for indicator width, formatted by locale/format, and complete when clamped value equals max. getAriaValueText(formattedValue,rawValue) or aria-valuetext supplies meaningful units. This reference requires finite min<max. The wrapper always inserts Track/Indicator after children; passing another Track in children duplicates the track. There is no timer, request, cancellation or onValueChange. The caller updates props and announces task completion/error separately.

The upload task, finite increasing bounds precondition, textual completion/error feedback and localized units are explicit caller policies. This informative progress display has no user-adjustable value or slider keyboard protocol.

ProgressLabel registers the task name; Root reports min/max/value/value text. ProgressValue visible text is aria-hidden because Root conveys it. Caller supplies explicit failure and completion messages outside the progressbar; color and width are supplementary.
